g.text: HARDWARE HEALTH CHAIN / EVERY INPUT MUST REMAIN HIGH

g.desc: HARDWARE HEALTH CHAIN / EVERY INPUT MUST REMAIN HIGH

g.text: /S=HEALTH_ALL; /R held HIGH; D=0. Fault asynchronously sets Q.

g.desc: /S=HEALTH_ALL; /R held HIGH; D=0. Fault asynchronously sets Q.

g.text: 10k / 10n delays the rising reset clock; hold ENABLE low >=1 ms after recovery.

g.desc: 10k / 10n delays the rising reset clock; hold ENABLE low >=1 ms after recovery.

g.text: Fault or invalid supplies block DRIVE_PERMIT directly.

g.desc: Fault or invalid supplies block DRIVE_PERMIT directly.

g.text: Recovery with ENABLE high cannot clear the latch or restart PWM.

g.desc: Recovery with ENABLE high cannot clear the latch or restart PWM.

g.text: FAULT_N is open collector; core-domain pull-up is on the MCU sub-board.

g.desc: FAULT_N is open collector; core-domain pull-up is on the MCU sub-board.

g.text: BASE_READY must be checked separately; an unpowered base cannot assert FAULT_N LOW.

g.desc: BASE_READY must be checked separately; an unpowered base cannot assert FAULT_N LOW.

g.text: Very short faults during reset may require a fresh disable cycle.

g.desc: Very short faults during reset may require a fresh disable cycle.
